Class
Description
AudienceRolesOpaqueTokenIntrospector
Decorates an introspector of the opaque-token variant: rejects tokens whose audience is not accepted and adds the role authorities of the roles attribute, so the opaque variant behaves like the JWT one.
BearerAuthorities
Maps the roles claim of a token onto authorities, for both JWT and opaque tokens.
DocumentController
Documents API, as the contract apis/resource-server/rest-server/resource-server-api-v1.yaml describes it through the generated DocumentsApi.
DocumentDtoMapper
Maps domain documents onto the DTO generated from the contract, so a domain model is never returned from DocumentController.
DocumentResponse
A document owned by a user.
DocumentsApi
 
OpenApiConfig
Runtime OpenAPI document of the HTTP API of the resource server, served by springdoc at "/v3/api-docs".
SecurityConfig
Secures the API: every request except the health endpoint and the OpenAPI document requires a valid bearer token issued by the authorization server for this resource server's audience.
StepUpAccessDeniedHandler
Answers a StepUpRequiredDecision with 401 and the RFC 9470 challenge (error="insufficient_user_authentication" with the required acr_values and max_age); every other denial goes to the delegate, the RFC 6750 handler.
StepUpAuthorizationManager
Requires that the bearer token proves a recent strong authentication (RFC 9470): its acr claim must be one of the configured (space-separated) values and its auth_time claim no older than the configured maximum age.
StepUpProperties
Step-up authentication policy (RFC 9470) of the sensitive operations, bound from resourceserver.step-up.*.
StepUpRequiredDecision
Denial that tells StepUpAccessDeniedHandler the caller is allowed to perform the operation but must authenticate again more strongly or more recently (RFC 9470), as opposed to an ordinary refusal.
